title: So... How Many of You Came to the Discussion?
body:
We have discussions, a DataFrame where each row describes one discussion section with the following columns:
• $$	ext{dist\_from\_bell}:$$ Distance between discussion section location and the Campanile in meters. $$(type=np.float32)$$
• $$	ext{section\_no}:$$ The week of the discussion section, between $$1$$ and $$13$$ inclusive. $$(type=np.int64)$$
• weather: Weather during discussion section. Can be "sunny", "cloudy", or "rainy". $$(type=str)$$
• $$	ext{attendance\_rate}:$$ The attendance rate of the discussion section, between $$0$$ and $$1$$ inclusive. (type=np.float32)
